-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Become a football manager in Soccer Manager 2027, a realistic football management game where you take control of elite football clubs and players. Navigate the transfer market, master football tactics and compete across more than 50 leagues in 36 countries worldwide. Experience the action unfold on the pitch with the improved 3D Match Motion Engine, bringing every match to life with greater realism and immersion. Soccer Manager 2027 delivers an authentic football management experience for fans of football games.
